schedules.title: Doctor schedules — {{branch}}

settings.title: Settings
settings.featuresHelp: Switch modules on or off for this branch only. Useful to try a new feature in one branch first.
settings.uhidPrefixHelp: Optional letters before the patient number. Empty gives plain numbers: 44. With AY: AY44
settings.multiBranchHelp: Off: the software works with your main branch only (no branch picker). Turn on when you open a second branch. No data is lost either way.
settings.upiIdHelp: Shown as a QR code on bills, e.g. clinic@okbank
settings.letterheadFooterHelp: Printed at the bottom of prescriptions, certificates and reports.
settings.letterheadFooterPlaceholder: e.g. Timings 10 am - 1 pm, 5 - 8 pm · Sunday closed
settings.logoHelp: PNG or JPG, up to 2 MB. A logo on a white or clear background prints best.
settings.padHelp: On: prescriptions are printed on your own pre-printed pad (it already has the logo, clinic, doctor and reg. no.). The software prints no letterhead and leaves blank space at the top and bottom. Measure your pad with a ruler.
settings.designHelp: Standard: the usual prescription. Ayurveda case sheet: one A4 page like a classic Ayurveda pad - clinic and doctor at the top, timings bar, लक्षण / निदान, Agni to Srotas on the left, Rx on the right, quote, services and address at the bottom. The timings come from "Footer line", the address and phone from above.
settings.printClosed: Holiday note (right of the timings bar)
settings.printServicesHelp: Separate with |   e.g. Consulting | Panchakarma | Medicine | Dietetics
settings.letterheadHelp: Upload your letterhead file (PDF, PNG or JPG, one A4 page). Prescriptions are then printed on top of it, so the preview and the PDF look exactly like your file. The free space at the top and bottom is found by itself; you can change it below.
settings.letterheadSaved: Letterhead saved. Free space: {{top}} mm at the top, {{bottom}} mm at the bottom.
settings.letterheadOnHelp: On: the picture is printed on the page (use this for PDF, WhatsApp and plain paper). Off: the picture is not printed (use this when you print on your own pre-printed paper).

audit.title: Audit log
audit.help: Every login, change and (later) every view, print and share of patient records is recorded here. Entries can never be edited or deleted.

patients.emailInvalid: This email address is not valid

patients.historyPrivate: Medical history is stored encrypted and is visible only to doctors.
patients.historyHidden: Only doctors can see the full medical history.
patients.consentHelp: Read the text to the patient in their language (or let them read it). Switch on only what the patient agrees to. Treatment consent is needed.
patients.consentRequired: Treatment consent is needed to register the patient.

patients.draftSaved: Draft kept in this browser tab

documents.help: Old reports, prescriptions and scans. PDF or photos, up to 10 MB.
documents.dropHere: Click or drag a file here
documents.allowed: PDF, JPG, PNG — up to 10 MB
documents.title: Title

consent.help: Consent for each purpose, as required by the DPDP Act. Records are never changed: every give or withdraw is added to the history.
consent.withdrawRequiredWarning: Without treatment consent the clinic cannot continue treatment. Medical records are still kept as the law requires.

appointments.title: Appointments
appointments.subtitle: {{n}} on this day

appointments.searchPatient: Type name, patient ID or mobile
appointments.patientHelp: New patient? Register them first on the Patients screen.
appointments.noConsent: No message sent: the patient has not given consent for SMS/WhatsApp messages (see the Consent tab).
appointments.chooseDoctorFirst: Choose a doctor to see the free times.
appointments.noDoctors: No doctors in this branch. Add one on the Staff screen.
appointments.confirmNoShow: Mark this patient as "did not come"?
appointments.patientTabHelp: Appointments of this patient in the current branch.
appointments.clickToStart: Doctor: click a patient to start the check-up. The patient becomes With doctor.

queue.title: Queue
queue.subtitle: Today. Updates by itself every {{seconds}} seconds.
queue.empty: Nobody in the queue today yet.
queue.tvOffline: Cannot reach the clinic server. Retrying...

consult.withoutAppointmentHelp: Search the patient. The check-up is saved under your name in this branch.
consult.appointmentsOff: Appointments are off. Use "Check-up without appointment".
consult.choosePatient: Choose a patient on the left to start the check-up.
consult.billHelp: Add procedures or other charges for this check-up to the patient's OPD bill
consult.completedMsg: Check-up completed. The appointment is marked done.
consult.visitsTabHelp: Check-ups from all branches. Click one to open it.
consult.pressEnterToAdd: Not in the list: press Enter to add your own words.
consult.noneAdded: Nothing added yet. Click a chip above or type and press Enter.
consult.historyPlaceholder: How it started, what makes it better or worse, earlier treatment...
consult.adviceNotesPlaceholder: Anything else to tell the patient
consult.followUpNotesPlaceholder: e.g. Come fasting for sugar test
consult.answerToScore: Answer the questions to see the score.
consult.scoreHelp: How bad is it today? 0 = none, 10 = worst
consult.progressHelp: Symptom score per visit (0 = none, 10 = worst). Add scores in Complaints.
consult.progressEmpty: No scores yet. Give each complaint a score (0-10) in Complaints to track progress.
consult.photoHelp: Photos are private: only staff who can see check-ups can open them. Take photos only with the patient's permission.
consult.reopenHelp: Use this if you pressed Complete visit by mistake or need to correct something. The prescription becomes a draft again until you complete the visit. Not possible after the pharmacy has given medicines.
consult.idHelp: Patient ID: the number that belongs to this patient for life.
consult.tokenHelp: Token: today's waiting-room number. A new one every day.
consult.step1: The receptionist gives a token or checks the patient in. The patient shows as Waiting.
consult.step2: Click the patient on the left. The check-up opens and the patient becomes With doctor.
consult.step3: Write complaints, diagnosis and medicines. Everything saves by itself.
consult.step4: Press Complete visit. The prescription goes to the pharmacy and the bill is ready.
consult.manyPatients: You may keep more than one patient With doctor and go back and forth; each one stays With doctor until you press Complete visit.
consult.completeEmptyAsk: Nothing is written in this check-up
consult.completeEmptyHelp: No complaint, diagnosis, notes or medicine yet. Complete it anyway? (You can re-open it later.)
consult.doneBar: Check-up completed. Print the prescription or go on with the next patient.

templatesAdmin.title: Check-up templates
templatesAdmin.subtitle: Questions the doctor clicks on the check-up screen. Changes create a new version; old check-ups keep their questions.
templatesAdmin.name: Name
templatesAdmin.versionHelp: Now version {{v}}. Saving changed questions makes a new version.
templatesAdmin.questionnaireHelp: Each answer counts for Vata, Pitta or Kapha. The software adds them up into a percentage score.

medicines.subtitle: {{n}} medicines · price and on/off are for this branch
medicines.searchPlaceholder: Search any name, synonym or ingredient
medicines.name: Name
medicines.inUseHelp: Switch off to hide it from prescriptions in this branch
medicines.historyHelp: Every saved change. Old prescriptions keep the version that was prescribed.
medicines.classicalHelp: Official name from the Ayurvedic Formulary / Pharmacopoeia of India, with its reference.
medicines.proprietaryHelp: A company's brand. Link it to its classical equivalent if there is one.
medicines.homeopathyHelp: Homeopathy remedies in a potency (30C, 200C, Q ...). Check the list with your homeopath or pharmacist.
medicines.synonymsHelp: Sanskrit, English, Hindi, Gujarati names, separated by commas. Used for searching.
medicines.gstHelp: Confirm the rate with your CA
medicines.safetyNotesPlaceholder: Shown to the doctor when prescribing

flagHelp.schedule_e1: Contains a Schedule E1 (poisonous) ingredient: only on prescription
flagHelp.contains_metals: Rasa / bhasma preparation: avoid long use without monitoring
flagHelp.pregnancy_caution: Warn when the patient is pregnant or breastfeeding

medicines.importHelp: Excel (.xlsx) or CSV. Use the template for the right columns.
medicines.dropFile: Click or drop the file here
medicines.dropHint: Existing medicines (same type and name) are updated; new ones are added.
medicines.previewNote: Preview only - nothing is saved yet. Check the list, then click Import.
medicines.barcodeHelp: Scan the product barcode into this box
medicines.allowLooseHelp: Part of a pack can be given
medicines.skuHelp: Your own short code; search finds it
medicines.notesPlaceholder: e.g. keep in a cool place
medicines.productHelp: A clinic product is something you sell that is not a medicine (oil, soap, supplement). It is sold from the Products menu, with stock and a GST bill like a medicine.

rx.title: Prescription
rx.linkedHelp: Changing the medicine days also changes the follow-up. Type another follow-up to keep it separate.
rx.quantityHelp: How many packs to give. It is worked out from: dose each time × times a day (M-N-N) × days, divided by what one pack holds (for example 30 tablets). You can type your own.
rx.continued_one: {{count}} medicine continued - check the dose and days
rx.continued_other: {{count}} medicines continued - check the doses and days
rx.saveTemplateHelp: Saves these {{n}} medicines with their doses, to use again for the same disease.
rx.templateDiagnosisHelp: Shown first (★) when this diagnosis is chosen
rx.searchMedicine: Search medicine to add (name, synonym, Gujarati / Hindi name)
rx.empty: No medicines yet. Search above, apply a template, or repeat a previous prescription.
rx.frequencyHelp: How many times a day: Morning - Noon - Night. 1-0-1 = morning and night. Quick: type 101. The dose is how much each time.
rx.instructions: e.g. chew, then drink warm water
rx.notesPlaceholder: e.g. Take with warm water. Stop if loose motions.

dosageCheck.format: Please check: write it like 1-0-1 or type 3 digits (101).
dosageCheck.high: Please check: more than 10 at one time?

rx.calc: {{dose}} {{unit}} each time × {{times}} time(s) a day × {{days}} days = {{total}} {{unit}} in all
rx.calcNoPack: pack size of this medicine is not set, type the quantity yourself
rx.calcMissing: Fill dose (with its unit), M-N-N and days: the total and the number of packs are worked out here.

pharmacy.title: Pharmacy
pharmacy.subtitle: Dispense medicines, stock by batch, purchases and suppliers
pharmacy.queueEmpty: No completed prescriptions on this day.
pharmacy.stockEmpty: No stock yet. Click "Add purchase" to enter medicines received.
pharmacy.expiredHelp: {{n}} packs have expired: remove them with Correct
pharmacy.reorderHelp: Shows "Low" when the stock is this many packs or fewer
pharmacy.correctHelp: Now {{n}} in this batch. Use a minus number to remove, plus to add.
pharmacy.purchasesHelp: Medicines received from suppliers. Saving a purchase adds the stock.
pharmacy.noSuppliersYet: Add suppliers on the Suppliers tab (optional).
pharmacy.addLineFirst: Fill medicine, batch, quantity and MRP in at least one line.
pharmacy.suppliersHelp: Who you buy medicines from. Shared by all branches.

alerts.copied: Alert text copied. Paste it in WhatsApp.

pharmacy.checkDoneHelp: Completed on {{date}}. Differences were posted to the stock ledger.
pharmacy.checkHelp: Count what is really on the shelves. On completion the stock is corrected and every difference is recorded.
pharmacy.checkRackHelp: Count one rack at a time, or leave empty for everything.
pharmacy.completeCheckHelp: The stock of every counted batch will be set to the counted quantity. This cannot be undone.
pharmacy.countHelp: Type the counted packs. Save as often as you like; complete when done.
pharmacy.ledgerHelp: Every stock movement with opening and closing balance.
pharmacy.noMovements: No stock movements in this period.
pharmacy.noRacks: No racks yet. Add your racks (A, B, C...) so medicines can be found quickly.
pharmacy.noRacksYet: Add racks first: Pharmacy -> Racks & suppliers.
pharmacy.openingHelp: Enter the stock you already have on the shelves (once, when you start using the software).
pharmacy.purchaseSearch: Invoice no., supplier, medicine or batch
pharmacy.racksHelp: Racks / cupboards in the pharmacy. Give each medicine a rack and shelf on the Stock tab.
pharmacy.returnHelp: Tick the medicines brought back. Sellable ones go back to stock; damaged ones do not.
pharmacy.salesHelp: Prescription sales and counter sales. Use Return when a customer brings medicines back.
pharmacy.scanPlaceholder: Scan barcode or type batch no.
pharmacy.scanUnknown: No medicine with barcode {{code}}. Add the barcode on the Medicines screen.
pharmacy.startCheckHelp: The current stock of every batch is noted. Then count the shelves and type what you find.
pharmacy.supplierReturnPlaceholder: e.g. Damaged in transit, near expiry
pharmacy.supplierReturnsHelp: To return stock: Stock tab -> open a medicine -> Return to supplier on the batch.
pharmacy.giveToOpd_one: Give {{count}} medicine & add to OPD bill
pharmacy.giveToOpd_other: Give {{count}} medicines & add to OPD bill
pharmacy.e1NeedsRx: {{name}} is a Schedule E1 medicine: sell it only against a doctor's prescription.
pharmacy.outOfStockName: {{name}}: no stock that can be sold.

needed.title: Asked for by doctors, not in stock
needed.help: Medicines written in prescriptions in the last 30 days that the pharmacy does not have now. Order these first.

pharmacy.printedTotalHelp: Type the final total printed on the bill. The software checks it against its own total.
pharmacy.totalDiffers: The invoice total ({{printed}}) is different from the calculated total ({{calc}}) by {{diff}}. Check the rates, discount, GST and quantities.
pharmacy.saveAnyway: The supplier invoice is right, save anyway
pharmacy.tickSaveAnyway: The totals differ. Check the lines, or tick 'save anyway'.
pharmacy.totalMatches: The total matches the supplier invoice.
pharmacy.expiryMissing: {{name}}: please enter the expiry date printed on the pack.

billing.cancelHelp: Makes a credit note; medicines go back to stock. The bill is kept.
billing.cancelHelpNoMedicine: Makes a credit note (money returned if paid). The bill is kept.
billing.cancelConfirmHelp: A credit note is made for the whole bill. Money paid is refunded.
billing.noUpiId: Add the branch UPI ID in Settings to show a payment QR code.
billing.upiHelp: After the patient pays, click Take payment -> UPI.
billing.searchPlaceholder: Bill no., patient name or ID
billing.title: Billing
billing.subtitle: OPD and pharmacy bills, payments, refunds and the day closing
billing.newOpdBillHelp: For a patient without an appointment today, e.g. only a dressing or a certificate. Patients with an appointment are billed from Appointments or the Queue.
billing.doctorOptional: Choose the doctor to add the consultation fee

additional.title: Additional settings
additional.subtitle: Optional features for the whole clinic. Switch on only what you need.
additional.keptNote: Switching a feature off only hides it. Nothing already saved is deleted; switch it on again to see it.
additional.onlyAdmin: Only an organization admin can change these switches.

opd_billing.label: OPD bills (consultation and services)
opd_billing.help: Make OPD bills for consultation fees and services (Agnikarma, Abhyanga ...), take payments, print. On by default. Off: the OPD bill buttons and the OPD collection card are hidden (nothing saved is deleted).

medicines_homeopathy.label: Homeopathy medicines
medicines_homeopathy.help: Shows homeopathy remedies, mother tinctures and biochemic salts in the Medicines list and on the prescription screen. Off: they are hidden (nothing is deleted).

pharmacy_billing.label: Pharmacy bills, payments and printing
pharmacy_billing.help: Dispensing makes a GST bill; take cash / UPI / card payments, print bills, UPI QR code, Bills tab with day closing. Off: medicines are only given, no bill.

pharmacy_discounts.label: Discounts on pharmacy bills
pharmacy_discounts.help: Discount % per medicine or on the whole bill when dispensing.

pharmacy_sales_returns.label: Sales returns
pharmacy_sales_returns.help: Take back medicines a patient returns: sellable ones go back to stock. With bills on, a credit note and refund are made.

pharmacy_loose_sale.label: Sell loose (part of a pack)
pharmacy_loose_sale.help: Sell single tablets from a strip. Set 'Units per pack' and 'Sell loose' on the medicine.

pharmacy_racks.label: Racks and shelf locations
pharmacy_racks.help: Make racks (A, B, C...) and record the rack, shelf and box of each medicine; shown while dispensing and counting.

pharmacy_barcode.label: Barcodes and scanning
pharmacy_barcode.help: Barcode on medicines and batches; scan to find stock, add purchase lines and pick the batch when dispensing.

pharmacy_purchase_details.label: Detailed purchase entry
pharmacy_purchase_details.help: Free quantity, discount, GST, manufacture month, selling price and freight on supplier invoices, with taxable value and GST totals.

pharmacy_opening_stock.label: Opening stock entry
pharmacy_opening_stock.help: Enter the stock you already have when you start, without a supplier invoice.

pharmacy_supplier_returns.label: Returns to supplier
pharmacy_supplier_returns.help: Send damaged, expired or extra stock back to the supplier; stock goes down and it is recorded.

pharmacy_stock_alerts.label: Stock alerts (low, out, expiry)
pharmacy_stock_alerts.help: Out-of-stock, low-stock, expiring-soon and expired counts on the Stock tab and the Dashboard, with quick filters.

pharmacy_stock_ledger.label: Stock ledger screen
pharmacy_stock_ledger.help: One screen with every stock movement (in, out, returns, corrections) and opening / closing balance, filtered by medicine and dates.

pharmacy_stock_check.label: Physical stock check
pharmacy_stock_check.help: Count what is really on the shelves (all or one rack); differences are corrected and recorded.

medicine_extra_details.label: Extra product details
medicine_extra_details.help: Generic name, category, pack type and default selling price on the medicine form.

combined_opd_bill.label: Medicines on the OPD bill (one combined bill)
combined_opd_bill.help: On: medicines given by the pharmacy are added to the patient's OPD bill of that visit, so the patient gets one bill. Off: the pharmacy makes its own pharmacy bill (keeps GST and the drug licence separate - ask your CA).

pharmacy_batch_tracking.label: Batch tracking
pharmacy_batch_tracking.help: Enter the batch number of each purchase. Off: stock is kept by expiry month (or as one lot) without batch numbers.

pharmacy_expiry_tracking.label: Expiry tracking
pharmacy_expiry_tracking.help: Expiry month on purchases and stock; the earliest expiry is given first.

pharmacy_purchase_price.label: Purchase price
pharmacy_purchase_price.help: Purchase rate on purchases and stock (needed for the detailed purchase entry).

pharmacy_selling_price.label: Selling price / MRP
pharmacy_selling_price.help: MRP and selling price of each batch (needed for pharmacy bills).

pharmacy_suppliers.label: Supplier management
pharmacy_suppliers.help: Supplier list and the supplier on purchases.

medicine_labels.label: Patient medicine labels
medicine_labels.help: Print a small label for each medicine given (from the pharmacy or the prescription). Medicine name, dose, days and instructions are always printed.

label_times.label: Label: morning / noon / night boxes
label_times.help: Big boxes like 1 | 0 | 1 under Morning, Noon, Night.

label_code.label: Label: QR code
label_code.help: Detailed label only. Holds the medicine barcode (or the bill / Rx number).

online_enquiry.label: Online enquiry from the clinic website
online_enquiry.help: Shows a public form (/enquiry) for your website and an Online enquiry screen where the front desk follows up. Off: the form is closed and the screen is hidden.

pharmacy_stock_labels.label: Pharmacy stock labels (barcode)
pharmacy_stock_labels.help: Labels for medicine packs on the shelf: medicine, pack, MRP, GST, batch, expiry and a barcode. No patient details. Print them from Stock (Labels button on a batch). Needs "Barcodes and scanning".

pharmacy_counter_sale.label: Counter sale (without a prescription)
pharmacy_counter_sale.help: A Counter sale tab: scan or search medicines, bill a walk-in customer and take payment. Schedule E1 medicines are never sold here. Needs "Pharmacy bills".

pharmacy_reports.label: Pharmacy reports
pharmacy_reports.help: A Reports tab: what to buy, daily report, top selling, slow medicines, margin and GST of pharmacy bills.

pharmacy_hold_bills.label: Hold a counter bill
pharmacy_hold_bills.help: On the Counter sale tab, put a bill on hold and finish it later (kept in this browser only).

digital_pad.label: Digital pad: handwritten prescription
digital_pad.help: Shows the Handwriting button in the doctor's check-up: write on the digital pad (or a tablet pen), and the handwriting is saved with the letterhead as one picture. Off: the button is hidden and no new handwriting can be saved; pages already written stay visible. Off by default.

clinic_products.label: Clinic products
clinic_products.help: Sell things that are not medicines (oils, soaps, supplements). Adds a Products menu for the doctor and the front desk, and a product kind in the medicine list. On by default.

separate_medicine_menu.label: Medicines as their own menu
separate_medicine_menu.help: Off (usual): the medicine list is a tab inside Pharmacy, so there is one place for medicines and stock. On: Medicines is a separate menu, for a clinic where a different person manages the medicine list.

label_format.label: Default label format
label_format.help: Compact 50x25 mm: medicine, dose, days, instructions. Standard 75x50 mm: adds patient, quantity, expiry. Detailed 100x70 mm: adds batch, price, QR code.

stock_label_format.label: Stock label size
stock_label_format.help: Small 50 × 25 mm or large 75 × 50 mm (adds the clinic name and HSN). You can change it in the print popup too.

fees.title: Fees & services
fees.subtitle: OPD consultation fee of each doctor, and the services & charges list for OPD bills
fees.consultationHelp: New case = first visit, or the last visit with this doctor was longer ago than the follow-up days. Follow-up = seen by this doctor within those days. Put 0 for a free follow-up.
fees.followUpDaysHelp: A revisit within these days is charged the follow-up fee
fees.noDoctors: No doctors in this branch yet.
fees.servicesHelp: Procedures, Panchakarma, tests, certificates... that can be added to an OPD bill. Prices include GST. Health care services are usually GST-free - confirm with your CA.
fees.noServices: No services yet. Add your procedures and charges.

opd.title: OPD bill - {{name}}
opd.feeNotSet: The consultation fee of this doctor is not set yet (menu: Fees & services). You can type the amount below.
opd.nothingNew: Nothing new to add. Add a service or take the payment.
opd.addSomething: Add the consultation fee or a service.
opd.confirmCreate: Create an OPD bill of {{amount}} for {{name}}.
opd.lateRevisit: Last visit {{date}}: {{days}} days ago (follow-up fee is only within {{limit}} days), so the new case fee applies

print.noConsent: The patient has not agreed to messages (Patient -> Consent).
print.certificateHelp: The certificate gets a number and cannot be deleted; a wrong one can only be cancelled. Check the dates.
print.certificateConfirm: Make this certificate now? It will get a number.
print.fitFrom: Fit to resume work / school from

verify.subtitle: Issued by the clinic below. Medical details are not shown here.
verify.notFoundHelp: This QR code does not match any document of the clinic. Please contact the clinic.

enquiry.title: Ask for an appointment
enquiry.subtitle: Tell us a little about yourself and our team at {{clinic}} will call you.
enquiry.name: Your name
enquiry.messageHelp: Please do not write private medical reports here.
enquiry.consent: I agree that {{clinic}} may call or message me about this enquiry.
enquiry.consentRequired: Please agree so that we can contact you.
enquiry.privacy: We use your details only to contact you about this enquiry.
enquiry.failed: Could not send. Please try again.
enquiry.thanksHelp: We have received your enquiry. Our team will contact you soon.
enquiry.closedHelp: Please call the clinic to book an appointment.
enquiry.pageSubtitle: People who asked for an appointment on the website, by phone or at the desk.
enquiry.websiteHelp: Put this link on the clinic website, or show the form inside the page with the embed code.
enquiry.waText: Namaste {{name}}, thank you for your enquiry. When would you like to visit the clinic?

stockLabels.title: Stock labels: {{name}}
stockLabels.help: One label for each pack: medicine, pack, MRP, GST, batch, expiry and a barcode. Scanning it at billing adds this batch.

counter.title: Counter sale
counter.scanPlaceholder: Scan the barcode on the label
counter.searchPlaceholder: Or search a medicine by name
counter.help: For a customer without a prescription. Scan the same pack again to add one more. Schedule E1 medicines need a prescription.
counter.empty: Scan a stock label or search a medicine to start.
counter.phoneInvalid: Mobile number must be 10 digits (or leave it empty).

reports.title: Reports
reports.subtitle: Money, doctors, patients and GST for any dates. Download as Excel or PDF.
reports.nothingAllowed: You may not see any report in this branch. An admin can allow it on the Roles screen.

help.collection: Money received each day or month: cash, UPI and card, minus refunds. Same figures as the day closing.
help.by_doctor: Bills of each doctor: consultation, services and medicines; billed, received and still due. Pharmacy bills count for the doctor who wrote the prescription.
help.by_branch: The same figures for each branch, to compare them.
help.patients: Patients seen: new cases (first check-up ever with the clinic) and follow-ups (seen before).
help.follow_ups: The follow-up date has passed and the patient has not come back. Call or message them.
help.gst: Taxable value and GST for each HSN / SAC code and rate, minus credit notes. Confirm with your CA before filing.
help.fy_summary: Every month of the financial year (1 April to 31 March): sales, GST, money received, purchases and the GST to pay. Choose the year above.
help.gst_payable: GST charged on sales (minus credit notes) against the GST paid on supplier purchases, for each rate. A guide only: your CA files the return.
help.sales_register: Every bill and credit note in order (credit notes in minus). Give this to your CA with the GST summary.
help.purchase_register: Every supplier invoice with the supplier GSTIN. Opening stock is not counted as a purchase.
help.dues: Bills where the patient has not paid everything yet. Phone numbers are hidden in part.

therapy.title: Panchakarma and therapy
therapy.subtitle: Therapy plans, the sessions of the day, therapists and rooms

record.title: Record the session
record.help: Written for the doctor to read at the next visit.

plan.title: Plan name
plan.titlePlaceholder: e.g. Virechana course, Knee Basti 7 days
plan.consent: The patient agrees to these procedures
plan.cancelAsk: Cancel this plan? Booked sessions are cancelled; done sessions stay.
plan.planned: Therapy plan saved. Book its sessions in Panchakarma, Therapy plans.

book.title: Book sessions: {{name}}
book.datesHelp: Pick every day this therapy should be done.

list.name: Name (English)
list.instructions: What the patient should do before and after
list.empty: No therapies yet. Add the starting list (Abhyanga, Shirodhara, Virechana ...) and change it as you like.

therapy.off: Panchakarma and therapy is switched off for this branch. Switch it on in Settings, Modules.
therapy.rescheduleHelp: This session was not done. Pick a new day and time, or cancel it.
therapy.keepTherapist: Keep the same therapist and room

undo.confirmBooking: Remove this booking made by mistake? The patient is not sent a message.

pdfSettings.title: PDF settings
pdfSettings.subtitle: How every print-out looks: prescription, bills, certificates, labels and reports. See the change on the right before you save.
pdfSettings.generalNote: These settings are used by every document. A document can change them in its own tab.
pdfSettings.docNote: Only what you change here is different for {{doc}}. Everything else follows the General tab.
pdfSettings.resetAsk: Remove the changes in this tab and go back to the default look?
pdfSettings.unsaved: You have changes that are not saved yet. The preview shows them; press Save to use them on real print-outs.
pdfSettings.discardAsk: You have unsaved changes. Discard them?
pdfSettings.fewOptions: This print-out has only a few options. Its size and look are fixed by the label printer.
pdfSettings.caseSheetNote: The Ayurveda case sheet (Settings -> Branch details) is one fixed A4 page: it follows the colour, logo, signature, QR and DUPLICATE settings, but not the text size, margin or extra header line.
pdfSettings.sourceReal: Preview of your latest real record
pdfSettings.sourceSample: Preview of a sample (no record yet)

paper.label: Paper size
paper.help: The paper this document opens with. You can still change it in the print window.

font_scale.label: Text size
font_scale.help: 100% is the usual size. Larger text may need a bigger paper.

show_logo.label: Show logo
show_logo.help: Also needs the logo to be switched on in Settings -> Clinic.

show_letterhead.label: Show clinic name and address
show_letterhead.help: Switch off if you print on your own letterhead paper.

header_text.label: Extra line at the top
header_text.help: For example your registration line or slogan.

footer_text.label: Extra line at the bottom
footer_text.help: For example timings or "Get well soon".

show_signature.label: Show signature box
show_signature.help: The doctor's signature (or the bill's signatory) at the bottom.

show_qr.label: Show QR code
show_qr.help: Documents: "is this genuine?" code. Bills: UPI "scan to pay" code.

show_duplicate_watermark.label: Write DUPLICATE COPY on reprints
show_duplicate_watermark.help: Switch off to print the same page again without the word.

language.label: Language
language.help: The patient's own language, or one fixed language for every print-out.

margin_mm.label: Margin
margin_mm.help: Empty space around the page. Empty = the usual margin of the paper.

show_gst_columns.label: Show HSN, batch, discount and GST columns
show_gst_columns.help: Switch off for a simpler bill. The GST totals stay.

terms_text.label: Terms and conditions
terms_text.help: Printed at the bottom of the bill.

thank_you_text.label: Thank-you line
thank_you_text.help: Replaces the usual line under the bill.

translate.hint: Fill Gujarati and Hindi from the English text (a suggestion: please check it)
translate.offline: AI is offline (start Ollama on this PC). You can type Gujarati and Hindi by hand.
translate.replaceAsk: Replace the Gujarati and Hindi with a new translation?

pharmacyReports.empty: Nothing to show for this report.
pharmacyReports.offNote: Not sold for the last 90 days.
pharmacyReports.reorderNote: Medicines at or below their reorder level. The suggested quantity brings stock up to twice the level.
pharmacyReports.marginNote: Sales without GST minus buying price. Medicines with no buying price are left out.
pharmacyReports.gstNote: Pharmacy bills only, after returns. Please check the figures with your CA.

handwriting.title: Handwritten prescription
handwriting.saveFailed: Could not save the handwriting. Please try again.
handwriting.savedHelp: Your handwriting and the clinic letterhead are saved together as one picture ({{number}}).
handwriting.unsavedAsk: The handwriting is not saved yet. Close without saving?
handwriting.hint: Write with the pad pen (set the pad to Mouse mode in iScribe4U), a tablet pen, your finger or a mouse.
handwriting.historyHelp: Every handwritten prescription page of this patient, latest first. Click a picture to enlarge, or open the check-up.

calendar.title: Calendar
calendar.subtitle: Which days have free time. Click a day to see its times and book.
calendar.pickDoctor: Choose a doctor to see the times.
calendar.noSlots: The doctor does not sit on this day.

investigations.pick: Search a test (e.g. CBC, sugar, X-ray)
investigations.notInList: "{{name}}" is not in the list. Press the button to advise it by this name.
investigations.help: Pick from the list or type any test name. When the patient brings the report, press Add report.
investigations.none: No tests advised in this check-up.
investigations.earlier: Reports still waiting from earlier check-ups ({{n}})
investigations.removeAsk: Remove this test from the check-up?

errorLog.title: Error log
errorLog.help: Everything that went wrong for anyone, from the moment they logged in: server errors, screens that crashed, lost connections, and actions that were refused. The same problem again is counted on one line. Press a line to see the steps the person took before it.
errorLog.levelHelp: Error = something broke. Warning = an action was refused. Notice = a mistake in what was entered.
errorLog.trail: What the person did before it (oldest first)
errorLog.noTrail: No steps were saved for this one.
errorLog.sessionHelp: Show everything from the same login
errorLog.copied: Copied. Paste it in the chat with Claude.
errorLog.searchHelp: Search by name, message, page or code

crash.title: This screen had a problem
crash.text: It has been written to the Error log, so it can be fixed. Your work before this is saved.

dues.help: Medicines bought on credit: what you owe each distributor, what is late, and the payments you made. Press a supplier to see the invoices and pay.
dues.none: Nothing is owed to any supplier yet. Buy medicines under a supplier (Purchases) and they appear here.
dues.whichInvoicesHelp: Leave empty to pay the oldest invoices first.
dues.reverseHelp: Use this for a payment entered by mistake. It stays in the account, marked reversed, and the amount is owed again.
dues.openingHelp: What you already owed this supplier on the day you started using the software.
dues.paidNowHelp: Money paid to the supplier today; the rest stays to pay.

products.title: Products
products.subtitle: Things the clinic sells that are not medicines: oils, supplements and more.
products.none: No products yet. Add one in Pharmacy > Medicine list (kind: Clinic product), then add stock in Pharmacy > Purchases.
products.emptyCart: Press Add on a product to start a bill.
